ARISE · A 10-week Christ-centered journey

You survived it.
But are you still carrying it?

Maybe what happened was years ago. Maybe you've forgiven, prayed, and moved forward. But shame, fear, patterns in relationships or the feeling that you're not enough may still follow you.

ARISE was created to help women explore what happened without letting it define who they are becoming.

See the Journey
Understanding the impact

The trauma may be over. But survival can keep going.

You may struggle with feeling safe, shame, boundaries, numbing, identity, or reconciling your faith with pain that remains. ARISE makes room to explore these experiences without shame.

You do not have to become the woman your trauma trained you to be.

Through Christ-centered teaching and reflection, ARISE invites women to discover who they are beyond what happened to them.

The program

Ten weeks. A guided path forward.

01 / WATCH

Learn

Follow the prerecorded teaching at a pace that works for you.

02 / WORK THROUGH

Reflect

Use the companion book and guided exercises to engage with the material.

03 / ARISE

Move forward

Explore identity, boundaries, faith and new patterns for your future.

Meet Sylvia Caldwell

A voice for healing, identity and generational legacy.

Sylvia Caldwell is a bestselling Christian author, entrepreneur, speaker, mentor and homeschooling mother of five.

Generationally minded at heart, Sylvia is passionate about helping women experience restoration through Christ, discover their God-given identity and see the impact of that freedom extend to the generations that follow.

Through ARISE, her writing, speaking and mentorship, she creates faith-centered spaces for women to explore healing and purposeful living.
